title: Reference approach: Image Classification Tool
approach: Build Image Classification Tool in small milestones. Implement: Create a dataset and transforms; Train a CNN baseline; Report validation results and misclassifications; Save a checkpoint; Run inference on an unseen image. Use synthetic data while developing, choose a documented dataset for the final experiment, and keep train/validation/test splits separate.

reference_snippets.code:
import torch
from torch import nn
model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(8, 16), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(16, 2)).eval()
with torch.inference_mode():
    output = model(torch.zeros(1, 8))
assert output.shape == (1, 2)
print("smoke test passed")
